expectations.text: The normal sequence is authorize, import, review mappings, Start sync after all mapped; import alone does not start sync.
expectations.evidence: Normal steps authorize, import, review mappings, then Start sync after all rows mapped; import alone explicitly does not start order sync.

expectations.text: It gives Mapping status location, Mapped/Unmatched conditions, and Link item or inventory-lead remedy only for Unmatched rows.
expectations.evidence: Names Connections > Products and Mapping status; leaves Mapped rows alone and applies Link item plus missing-item escalation only to Unmatched rows.

expectations.text: Disconnect/reimport and Reauthorize are clearly conditional on wrong shop and Authorization expired respectively, not universal prerequisites.
expectations.evidence: Wrong-shop recovery begins If Connections > Account shows the wrong shop; Reauthorize begins If sync status is Authorization expired and says only needed for that status.
